newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit eases slightly on fresh selling vs Sing.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit eases slightly on fresh selling vs Sing.

text.p: The ringgit was slightly easier against the dollar on selling triggered by fresh ringgit/Singapore dollar unwinding, dealers said on Thursday.
Dealers said ringgit moved back above 2.52 a dollar level around 0830 GMT, on selling by Kuala Lumpur and London players.
"Customers are selling ringgit against Sing. That has triggered interbank players to follow," a dealer with a foreign bank in Kuala Lumpur said.
However, the decline will be limited to 2.5225 a dollar today as most of the activity was squaring-up or adjusting positions for the day, he said.
He said the range trading would continue on Friday in the absence of any fresh market moving factors.
One dealer said the ringgit's gains since Wednesday were partly due to those investing in the domestic stock market. "But, in the absence of sustained flows, dollar/ringgit is rebounding," he said.
Dealers said the general strategy being adopted was to buy at every dip and sell about 20 points higher.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5205/12 a dollar against 2.5193/98 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday. The Singapore dollar was at 0.5555/60 a dollar against 0.5560/63.
